station_name: Whitewater River at White Water, Calif.
township_range_section: NW¼NW¼NE¼ sec.2, T.3 S., R.3 E.
notes: Foot rows marked with daggers give monthly runoff in acre-feet from an infiltration line that bypasses the station and of water diverted from the basin 15 miles upstream (furnished by water and power companies): a different measured quantity in the foot rows, so runoff is listed; the Ac-ft row and the "adjusted" row are conversions and sums. The peak-discharge line gives one gage height (7.04 ft), so gage_height is listed. No county printed. Other distances on the page: 1.5 miles north of White Water, 3½ miles upstream from San Gorgonio River.
